summary: Iteration 6 testing complete. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass — DELETE /api/admin/menu/{id} (success, invalid id -> 400, non-existent -> 404, non-admin -> 403, audit log with date/meal_type/items meta), admin override booking (200 response with admin_override marker, override_reason echoed, audit meta has all required fields, both-meals flow writes 2 audit rows). Frontend: All 4 UI checks pass (login branding, menu delete via window.confirm + toast, force-book employee search input, 'Both meals' option in meal dropdown that fires 2 POSTs and shows 'Both meals booked' toast). Found and fixed one critical runtime bug on Admin Dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: menuDeleteBusy state was referenced in JSX (line ~900) and inside deleteMenu() but never declared with useState — caused 'ReferenceError: menuDeleteBusy is not defined' and crashed the entire Admin Dashboard as soon as any menu row was rendered. FIXED by adding `const [menuDeleteBusy, setMenuDeleteBusy] = useState(null);` next to the other menu-tab state.

action_items: None blocking — the missing menuDeleteBusy state was fixed by testing agent (a one-line addition). Main agent should verify the fix is acceptable style-wise.
Consider: admin-create-booking endpoint responds 200 (not 201) on create; iteration 5 tests already assumed 200 so this is consistent, but worth noting as slight REST-style deviation.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx (>1000 lines) should be split into per-tab components similar to AdminBookingsTab.jsx — the missing menuDeleteBusy state slipped through precisely because the file is enormous.

server.py admin_create_booking: when updating an existing booking (line 1509-1524), audit action 'admin.booking.override_update' meta uses short keys (emp, meal, date, qty) while the create path uses long keys (employee_number, meal_type, meal_date, quantity). Consider normalising for easier audit-log parsing.

server.py admin_create_booking notification email is only sent on the create branch. If an admin overrides an existing booking (update branch), no email is dispatched — arguably the employee should be notified there too.
